sources.snippet: Layerfault Offline-first static admission and sandboxed behavioural security for local AI models. Layerfault validates model artifacts, packages and local runtimes before inference, then can optionally exercise supported models inside a locked-down Linux sandbox to look for runtime side effects and suspicious behavioural divergence.

sources.snippet: Layerfault is an offline-first security and admission-control CLI for local AI models. It validates model structure and package contents, establishes integrity and package identity, evaluates provenance and local trust, applies operator policy, checks relevant runtime security advisories, and can block execution when those guarantees fail.

sources.snippet: The way to determine if you can use this way is through looking into the "Files and versions" in HuggingFace model tab and see if there is a tokenizer.json. If there is a tokenizer.json, you can get it directly through DJL.
